title: 第3章 爷不吃你那一套爷去也第4章 众望所归千里相送
slug: 被逐出宗门后师尊师姐后悔终生
content_zh:
现场一片寂静，时间仿佛陷入了停滞，只有契约书上那鲜艳的红痕分外刺目。
契约成！
紧接着，契约书散发着光芒，一分为二，分别落到了周通和莫流苏的手中。
“你竟敢！！！”
莫流苏率先打破沉默，她身上散发出了冷酷的气息，冰寒刺骨，空气都为之冻结。
与此同时，她的脸上不再有任何表情，犹如一块万古不化的玄冰，瞳孔幽然，深不见底。
所有人心头都“咯噔”一声！
他们知道，事情已经不可挽回了，周通的强硬做派彻底触怒了莫流苏！
葛红秋，姜玉瑶和唐七三人对视一眼，均看到了对方眼中的喜色。
师尊一旦进入这种状态，就绝对不会再留情面。
“周通，从今日起你被逐出师门，以后不得以玉清宗弟子的身份自居，更不能使用玉清宗的绝学，若敢违背，我定不饶你！”
“我之所求，本该如此。”
周通从怀中拿出了一块玉佩，此玉古朴精美，散发着温暖祥和的气息。
不难看出，此玉被保养的极好，可见它的主人是何等的珍重它。
“你拿这东西干什么？”
莫流苏瞳孔一缩，这块玉佩本是周通拜师时她赠与周通的信物，原是一块普通的玉石，没想到周通会随身携带。
“原物奉还！”
周通将玉佩递出，却被莫流苏随手打出的一道气劲击得粉碎。
“被你碰过的肮脏之物，我要来做甚？”
“那请把我的信物也还回来！”

周通伸出手，无比认真的说道。
此话一出，莫流苏神色一滞，她依稀记得，当时周通曾亲手雕刻了一颗精致的木珠作为信物送给了她，却早就被她丢到了不知何处。
“那种垃圾，你以为我会随身携带吗，怎么？难道你还想讹我不成！”
她嘲讽的说道，刻薄至极，丝毫不给周通留情面。
“无所谓！”
周通耸了耸肩膀，那颗木珠上暗藏着他少年时的心思，既然已被丢弃，就没有再追究的必要了。
“后会有期！”
他转身就要离去，莫流苏眼中的冷意却又旺盛了几分。
“等一下，你这一身修为都是拜宗门所赐，既然要离开，是不是应该全部留下？”
此话一出，就连诸位长老都难以置信的看向了莫流苏。
她竟然要让周通自废修为，这是何等的狠心！
周通也停下了脚步，回头看着这个绝美的女人，脸上浮现出了冷色！
“真是好大的脸！这些年来你又何曾教导过我？就连修炼的灵石都是我费尽艰辛自己赚的，和你又有什么关系！”
此话一出，不少人都倒吸凉气。
周通这些年过得真的有这么苦吗？没有师尊教导，没有修炼资源，简直比杂役都不如。
如果这都是真的，周通凭借自学都能达到这种地步，他的天赋将高到一种令人恐怖的程度！
“不要说这些没用的，你现在的样子真像一只丧家之犬！”
莫流苏高高在上的看着周通，冷漠的令人发颤。
“不管怎么说，宗门也保护了你这么多年，否则你未必能活到现在，你想一走了之，那是不可能的，
若你真舍不得废掉一身修为，就要在宗门内做十年最低贱的杂役，十年之后，一笔勾销！”

她一边说着，一边掏出了一枚令牌，令牌上赫然印着三个金色的大字：宗主令！
持此令牌，莫流苏可以代行宗主的权利，她的话在玉清宗就是圣旨！
周通今日想要离去，除了自废修为，没有第二条路好走。
莫流苏心中无比得意，她觉得自己已经拿捏住了周通，因为她不认为周通能舍得一身修为，任何人都做不到。
“我可不吃你这一套，若是这样就能和你斩断联系，我倒觉得赚了。”
content_en:
The scene was silent, and time seemed to have stood still. Only the bright red marks on the contract were particularly dazzling.
The contract is made!
Immediately afterwards, the contract emitted light, split into two, and fell into the hands of Zhou Tong and Mo Liusu respectively.
"How dare you!!!"
Mo Liusu was the first to break the silence. She exuded a cold aura, so cold that it froze the air.
At the same time, there was no longer any expression on her face, just like a piece of eternal ice, her pupils were dark and bottomless.
Everyone's heart "thumped"!
They knew that the matter was irreversible, and Zhou Tong's hard-line attitude completely angered Mo Liusu!
Ge Hongqiu, Jiang Yuyao and Tang Qi looked at each other and saw the joy in each other's eyes.
Once Master enters this state, he will never show mercy again.
"Zhou Tong, from today onwards you are expelled from the master. You will not be able to claim to be a disciple of the Yuqing Sect in the future, let alone use the unique skills of the Yuqing Sect. If you dare to violate it, I will not spare you!"
"This is what I want."
Zhou Tong took out a jade pendant from his arms. This jade was simple and exquisite, exuding a warm and peaceful atmosphere.
It is not difficult to see that this jade has been well maintained, which shows how much its owner cherishes it.
"What are you doing with this?"
Mo Liusu's pupils shrank. This jade pendant was originally a token she gave to Zhou Tong when he became a disciple. It was originally an ordinary jade stone, but he didn't expect Zhou Tong to carry it with him.
"Return the original!"
Zhou Tong handed out the jade pendant, but it was smashed into pieces by Mo Liusu's casual energy.
"What do I want to do to the dirty things you touched?"
"Then please return my token!"
Zhou Tong stretched out his hand and said extremely seriously.
As soon as these words came out, Mo Liusu's expression froze. She vaguely remembered that Zhou Tong had carved a delicate wooden bead with his own hands and gave it to her as a token, but she had long ago thrown it away somewhere.
"Do you think I would carry that kind of garbage with me? What? Do you still want to blackmail me?"
She said sarcastically, being extremely mean and showing no mercy to Zhou Tong.
"It doesn't matter!"
Zhou Tong shrugged his shoulders. The wooden bead contained the thoughts of his youth. Since it had been discarded, there was no need to pursue it further.
"See you later!"
He turned around and was about to leave, but the coldness in Mo Liusu's eyes became stronger.
"Wait a minute, your cultivation is all thanks to the sect. Since you are leaving, should you stay behind?"
As soon as these words came out, even the elders looked at Mo Liusu in disbelief.
She actually wants Zhou Tong to abandon his cultivation. How cruel is this!
Zhou Tong also stopped and looked back at this beautiful woman, with a cold look on his face!
"What a shame! How have you taught me all these years? Even the spiritual stones I cultivated were earned by myself with all the hard work, so what does it have to do with you!"
As soon as these words came out, many people took a breath.
Has Zhou Tong really had such a hard time these years? Without the guidance of the master and the resources for cultivation, he is worse than a handyman.
If this is true, and Zhou Tong can reach this level by relying on self-study, his talent will reach a terrifying level!
"Don't talk nonsense, you look like a lost dog now!"
Mo Liusu looked at Zhou Tong from above, with a trembling indifference.
"In any case, the sect has protected you for so many years, otherwise you may not be able to survive until now. If you want to run away, that is impossible.
If you are really unwilling to give up your cultivation, you will have to work as the lowest servant in the sect for ten years. After ten years, it will be written off! "
As she spoke, she took out a token with three large golden characters printed on it: Order of the Sect Master!
With this token, Mo Liusu can act as the sect leader, and her words are imperial edicts in the Yuqing Sect!
Zhou Tong wants todayTo leave, there is no other way except to abandon one's cultivation.
Mo Liusu was extremely proud. She felt that she had grasped Zhou Tong, because she didn't think that Zhou Tong could give up his cultivation, and no one could do it.
"I'm not going to accept your tricks. If I can cut off contact with you this way, I feel like I've made a profit."
